hero.title: Independent Measurement for AI Safety
hero.subtitle: We measure AI systems against the rules that govern them, sign the card, and publish what we cannot measure. We do not certify and we do not remediate.

training.title: AI Safety Training
training.description: Training records attest training, not conformity

certification.title: AI Safety Course (Council Academy)
certification.description: Complete the course to attest your AI safety training—the Council measures, it does not certify

watchdog.title: The Watchdog Programme
watchdog.description: Join our network of AI Safety Analysts

enterprise.title: Get measured
enterprise.description: Describe the system. We measure, sign, and publish what we cannot measure. Empty cells stay empty. We do not remediate.

ask.label: Get results
ask.description: Type a model, server or record: see what is already measured, free, then request a fresh run or a monthly watch.

mine.label: My results
mine.description: Where your request stands, the signed results once delivered, and a free check.

verify.label: Check a result
verify.description: Check any signed result yourself, in your browser: genuine (VALID), not genuine (INVALID) or not checkable.

board.label: Leaderboard
board.description: What we measured, on which tests, read live. A tie stays a tie; nothing is called best.

connect.label: For developers
connect.description: Add the tools to Claude, Cursor or your agent; protocol doors and the tool console.

learn.label: Learn
learn.description: Learn how each test works, replay recorded model rounds, practise, and inspect continuous research.

staff.label: Staff & human review
staff.description: Escalate an AI staff proposal to a named human, check understanding of the published record, and inspect decision, signing and persistence gates.

sovx.label: SovX
sovx.description: Reads of wrapped and bridged stablecoins, for wallets and agents. A read, not a rating.

corrections.label: Corrections
corrections.description: Every correction we have published and the claims we keep re-checking.

academy.label: Academy
academy.blurb: Council Academy — learn the statute and the method. Completion-record issuance is not currently open.

ruler.label: The Ruler
ruler.blurb: Label the same frozen items the published models were measured on, and bet which seat is the model's. Local practice; nothing is sent anywhere.

him.label: H.I.M. review
him.blurb: The human-in-the-loop layer by name: where an AI proposal stops, who decides, and which gates are live. A receipt records a decision; it does not certify it.
